text.tspan: Support chatbot — success, failure & escalation paths (v2)
Day 03 · extends v1 with timeout, retry, fallback and human hand-off
• Timeout: 10 s per LLM call (no reply = failure)
• Retry: max 3 attempts, backoff 1 s → 2 s
• Fallback: FAQ search, no LLM, score ≥ 0.8
• Escalate: out of scope, unsafe, or fallback missed
• Agent wait: 2 min, then async ticket
